description.en: Cybion's built-in operating guide (shipped with the source, shared by every user, read-only): how to work with features like the Ultimate Machine. Read this first when you need operating guidance; the two standing user Manuals (Project Index, Value Bias) and their format live in the nodes of the same name.
description.zh: Cybion 自带的操作指南（随源码发布、所有用户共享、只读）：如何用终极机器等功能干活。需要操作指导时先读这里；两个常备用户手册（项目索引、价值偏置）的钩子与格式见同名节点。

description.en: The Ultimate Machine: runs one bash check on a Worker on schedule and asks its bound Thread to repair failures; quiet otherwise.
description.zh: 终极机器：在 Worker 上按期执行一条 bash 检查命令，失败时请绑定的 Thread 修复；平时保持沉默。

description.en: Linkit's role in Cybion: identity, notifications and reach; why there are no linkit_* tools on the model side.
description.zh: Linkit 在 Cybion 中的角色：身份、通知与触达；为什么模型侧没有 linkit_* 工具。

description.en: Project Index: the user's projects as routing blocks of project / location (Worker label:path or remote URL) / summary; maintained while you work.
description.zh: 项目索引：把用户的项目记成「项目 / 位置 / 简介」的路由清单（位置是 Worker 标签:路径或远端地址），干活时顺手维护。

description.en: Value Bias: four-field blocks (scenario / tension / choice / evidence) recording what the user chose under a real trade-off; apply it first, then let him overrule.
description.zh: 价值偏置：四段式块（场景 / 张力 / 选择 / 依据）记录用户在真实取舍上的选择；下次冲突时先用，用完给他推翻的机会。

description.en: Manual Format: the default layout of agent-maintained user Manuals — one block per entry, fields ending with a colon, a blank line between blocks, converge near 60 lines.
description.zh: 用户手册格式：这类由 Agent 维护的用户手册的默认排版——一条一个块、字段名以冒号结尾、块间空行、收敛到约 60 行。
